SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (
  SELECT CreatedTime FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT CreatedTime FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT CreatedTime FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT CreatedTime FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
) a

SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM (
  SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
) a

SELECT COUNT(*) AS running FROM (
  SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Running'
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Running'
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Running'
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Running'
) a

SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS success_rate FROM (
  SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
) a

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'sendfile' AS [Workflow],
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 5 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Healthy' END AS Health,
    COUNT(*) AS [Total Runs],
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Succeeded,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Failed,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS [Success%],
    CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN EndTime IS NOT NULL AND EndTime > CreatedTime THEN DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime) END) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS [Avg(s)],
    MAX(CreatedTime) AS [Last Run]
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'mllpreceiove',
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 5 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Healthy' END,
    COUNT(*),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)),
    CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN EndTime IS NOT NULL AND EndTime > CreatedTime THEN DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime) END) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)),
    MAX(CreatedTime)
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'wf2',
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 5 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Healthy' END,
    COUNT(*),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)),
    CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN EndTime IS NOT NULL AND EndTime > CreatedTime THEN DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime) END) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)),
    MAX(CreatedTime)
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'hello-workflow',
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 5 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Healthy' END,
    COUNT(*),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,1)),
    CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN EndTime IS NOT NULL AND EndTime > CreatedTime THEN DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime) END) / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)),
    MAX(CreatedTime)
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
) t WHERE [Total Runs] > 0 ORDER BY Failed DESC, [Total Runs] DESC

SELECT TOP 50 * FROM (
  SELECT 'sendfile' AS Workflow, FlowRunSequenceId AS RunId, Status, Code, TriggerName, CreatedTime, EndTime, DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime) AS Duration_ms
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns]
  WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'mllpreceiove', FlowRunSequenceId, Status, Code, TriggerName, CreatedTime, EndTime, DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs]
  WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'wf2', FlowRunSequenceId, Status, Code, TriggerName, CreatedTime, EndTime, DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs]
  WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'hello-workflow', FlowRunSequenceId, Status, Code, TriggerName, CreatedTime, EndTime, DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns]
  WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND Status='Failed'
) t ORDER BY CreatedTime DESC

SELECT $__timeGroup(CreatedTime,'5m') AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Succeeded,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Status='Running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Running
FROM (
  SELECT CreatedTime, Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT CreatedTime, Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba2207ab2e2103e70runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT CreatedTime, Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba9624d4d600b6d80runs] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
  UNION ALL SELECT CreatedTime, Status FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba21fc14c095f059aruns] WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime)
) a
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(CreatedTime,'5m')
ORDER BY time

SELECT Workflow, CAST(P50 / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS P50, CAST(P95 / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS P95, CAST(P99 / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS P99, Runs
FROM (
  SELECT 'sendfile' AS Workflow,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)) OVER() AS P50,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)) OVER() AS P95,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)) OVER() AS P99,
    COUNT(*) OVER() AS Runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CreatedTime) AS rn
  FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18ba4f5dbacebb23b6aruns]
  WHERE $__timeFilter(CreatedTime) AND EndTime IS NOT NULL AND EndTime > CreatedTime
) t WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL

SELECT Workflow, CAST(P50 / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,3)), CAST(P95 / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,3)), CAST(P99 / 1000.0 AS DECIMAL(10,3)), Runs FROM (
  SELECT 'hello-workflow' AS Workflow,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CreatedTime, EndTime)) OVER() AS P50,

SELECT
  CASE JobPartition
    WHEN 'E2C831A799FC4589BC4F7D330588C67C' THEN 'sendfile'
    WHEN 'D485C5348EEC4CEF83D98224E1BFF08A' THEN 'wf2'
    WHEN '20D52BC709D44E65ACCA0A357B5A3029' THEN 'mllpreceiove'
    WHEN '69D04229180D440292B5B785F3A967C0' THEN 'hello-workflow'
    ELSE JobPartition END AS Workflow,
  JobId AS [Trigger], State, LastExecutionStatus AS [Last Status],
  LastExecutionTime AS [Last Exec], NextExecutionTime AS [Next Exec],
  TotalSucceededCount AS Succeeded, TotalFailedCount AS Failed, CurrentRetryCount AS Retries
FROM [dt].[flowbbf0356a73a18bajobdefinitions]
WHERE JobId LIKE 'FlowTriggerJob%'
ORDER BY LastExecutionTime DESC
